description_target.target_text: Connect rectangles via MST: corridors with walls at extremes of bbox interior overlap, holes in facing walls

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Hollow rooms get joined by corridors. Every horizontally/vertically
 ;; facing room pair with an unobstructed gap is a candidate edge
 ;; (cost = gap width, corridor spanning the shared interior rows/
 ;; cols); Kruskal's MST keeps the cheapest set that connects all
 ;; rooms. Each kept corridor draws its two green(3) side walls across
 ;; the gap and knocks door holes through both facing room walls.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define boxes (map obj-bbox (objects g 0)))
     (define n (length boxes))
     (define (box i) (nth boxes i))
     (define (r1 b) (nth b 0))
     (define (c1 b) (nth b 1))
     (define (r2 b) (nth b 2))
     (define (c2 b) (nth b 3))
     (define (edge-h i j)  ;; i strictly left of j, corridor unblocked
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (c2 bi) (c1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (r1 bi) 1) (+ (r1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (r2 bi) 1) (- (r2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (c2 (box k)) (+ (c2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (c1 (box k)) (- (c1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (r1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (r2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (c1 bj) (c2 bi) 1) i j 'h lo hi))))))
     (define (edge-v i j)  ;; i strictly above j
       (let ((bi (box i)) (bj (box j)))
         (and (< (r2 bi) (r1 bj))
              (let ((lo (max (+ (c1 bi) 1) (+ (c1 bj) 1)))
                    (hi (min (- (c2 bi) 1) (- (c2 bj) 1))))
                (and (<= lo hi)
                     (not (any? (lambda (k)
                                  (and (not (= k i)) (not (= k j))
                                       (>= (r2 (box k)) (+ (r2 bi) 1))
                                       (<= (r1 (box k)) (- (r1 bj) 1))
                                       (<= (max (+ (c1 (box k)) 1) lo)
                                           (min (- (c2 (box k)) 1) hi))))
                                (range 0 n)))
                     (list (- (r1 bj) (r2 bi) 1) i j 'v lo hi))))))
     (define edges  ;; (gap i j dir lo hi), cheapest first
       (sort-by (filter (lambda (e) e)
                        (flatmap (lambda (i)
                                   (flatmap (lambda (j)
                                              (if (= i j)
                                                  (list)
                                                  (list (edge-h i j)
                                                        (edge-v i j))))
                                            (range 0 n)))
                                 (range 0 n)))
                first))
     (define mst  ;; Kruskal over list components
       (let loop ((comps (map (lambda (i) (list i)) (range 0 n)))
                  (eds edges) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? eds)
             (reverse acc)
             (let* ((e (first eds))
                    (find-comp (lambda (x)
                                 (find (lambda (c) (member? x c)) comps)))
                    (ci (find-comp (second e)))
                    (cj (find-comp (third e))))
               (if (equal? ci cj)
                   (loop comps (rest eds) acc)
                   (loop (cons (append ci cj)
                               (filter (lambda (c)
                                         (and (not (equal? c ci))
                                              (not (equal? c cj))))
                                       comps))
                         (rest eds) (cons e acc)))))))
     (define (corridor out e)
       (let ((bi (box (second e))) (bj (box (third e)))
             (lo (fifth e)) (hi (nth e 5)))
         (if (eq? (fourth e) 'h)
             (let ((gc1 (+ (c2 bi) 1)) (gc2 (- (c1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect lo gc1 lo gc2)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect hi gc1 hi gc2) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c2 bi)
                                           (- hi 1) (c2 bi))
                        (positions-in-rect (+ lo 1) (c1 bj)
                                           (- hi 1) (c1 bj)))
                0))
             (let ((gr1 (+ (r2 bi) 1)) (gr2 (- (r1 bj) 1)))
               (paint-cells
                (paint-cells (paint-cells out
                                          (positions-in-rect gr1 lo gr2 lo)
                                          3)
                             (positions-in-rect gr1 hi gr2 hi) 3)
                (append (positions-in-rect (r2 bi) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r2 bi) (- hi 1))
                        (positions-in-rect (r1 bj) (+ lo 1)
                                           (r1 bj) (- hi 1)))
                0)))))
     (reduce corridor g mst))))
